# Internet Timeline

Internet Timeline is a free daily browser game about internet history, web history and digital culture.

Players place five historical events into chronological order. The game covers early networking, the World Wide Web, search, email, ecommerce, social media, mobile computing, gaming, streaming, cloud computing, cybersecurity, cryptocurrency, internet culture and artificial intelligence.

## Canonical URL
https://daily-foundry.vercel.app/

## Key pages

- Daily history games and timeline-game format guide: https://daily-foundry.vercel.app/daily-history-games/

- About, sourcing and scheduling methodology: https://daily-foundry.vercel.app/about/
- Open-source project: https://github.com/7l7/DailyFoundry

## Game facts
- Free to play in a web browser.
- No account is required.
- One deterministic daily puzzle is shared by all players.
- Each puzzle contains one anchor event plus five placement rounds.
- Past puzzles remain replayable in the archive.
- Practice mode provides additional random timelines.
- Daily scheduling avoids recent repeats and same-year collisions and mixes eras, categories and difficulty.
- Question records include explanations and source URLs.
- Primary and institutional sources are preferred when available.

## Topic definition
Internet Timeline is a daily history game and chronology puzzle focused specifically on the history of the internet, the World Wide Web, digital platforms and online culture.
